command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Write-Host "===== RECAPTURE BOOKMARK VISUAL EVIDENCE ====="
git fetch origin main work/bookmarks-winui --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git fetch failed" }
$expected="5228cbbfc24f56d61a84975545f1d8572e7deece"
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne $expected) { throw "main moved" }
$status=@(git status --short)
if($status.Count -ne 0){$status|%{Write-Host $_};throw "unexpected local changes"}

$capture=@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from ctypes import wintypes as W
from pywinauto import Desktop
from PIL import ImageGrab

ROOT=Path.cwd()
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
mode=os.environ["BOOKMARK_VISUAL_MODE"]
target=ROOT/"logs"/f"bookmark-visual-{mode}-foreground.png"
owned=ROOT/"logs"/"bookmark-visual-owned"
shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)
source=owned/"북마크원본"
appdata=owned/"appdata";localdata=owned/"localdata";temp=owned/"tmp"
for q in (source,appdata,localdata,temp):q.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(source/"owned.txt").write_text("visual fixture",encoding="utf-8")
profile=localdata/"flyExplorer";profile.mkdir()
(profile/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(
 b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
# Keep the same profile payload for both binaries; old main simply ignores
# the bookmark file while the changed binary renders it.
(profile/"bookmarks-v1.txt").write_text(
 "schema=1\r\n자주 쓰는 폴더\t"+str(source)+"\r\n",
 encoding="utf-8",newline="")
env={**os.environ,"APPDATA":str(appdata),"LOCALAPPDATA":str(localdata),
     "TEMP":str(temp),"TMP":str(temp)}
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(source)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env,
 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM]
u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.GetForegroundWindow.restype=W.HWND
u.SetForegroundWindow.argtypes=[W.HWND]
u.SetWindowPos.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.HWND,c.c_int,c.c_int,c.c_int,c.c_int,W.UINT]
u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]
def owned_windows():
 out=[]
 @CALL
 def cb(h,_):
  pid=W.DWORD();u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(pid))
  if pid.value==proc.pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h):out.append(int(h))
  return 1
 u.EnumWindows(cb,0);return out
def eventually(fn,label,timeout=18):
 end=time.monotonic()+timeout
 while time.monotonic()<end:
  try:
   if fn():return
  except Exception:pass
  time.sleep(.12)
 raise AssertionError(label)
eventually(lambda:owned_windows() or proc.poll() is not None,"window not found")
assert proc.poll() is None,proc.returncode
hwnd=owned_windows()[0]
win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
address=win.child_window(auto_id="AddressBox")
eventually(lambda:str(source).lower() in address.get_value().lower(),
           "initial navigation not settled")
u.SetWindowPos(hwnd,0,120,70,972,720,0x0040)
for _ in range(6):
 try:win.set_focus()
 except Exception:pass
 u.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)
 time.sleep(.15)
 fg=u.GetForegroundWindow()
 owner=W.DWORD()
 if fg:u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg,c.byref(owner))
 if owner.value==proc.pid:break
else:
 raise AssertionError("flyExplorer never became the foreground process")
assert "flyExplorer" in win.window_text(),win.window_text()
# Verify a product-owned control is visible immediately before capture.
assert win.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles").is_visible()
time.sleep(.4)
rect=win.rectangle()
assert (rect.width(),rect.height())==(972,720),(rect.width(),rect.height())
ImageGrab.grab(bbox=(rect.left,rect.top,rect.right,rect.bottom),
               include_layered_windows=True).save(target)
print("VISUAL_CAPTURE",mode,target,flush=True)
print("WINDOW_TITLE",repr(win.window_text()),flush=True)
print("FOREGROUND_PID",proc.pid,flush=True)
print("RECT",(rect.left,rect.top,rect.right,rect.bottom),flush=True)
u.PostMessageW(hwnd,0x0010,0,0)
proc.wait(timeout=12)
assert proc.returncode==0,proc.returncode
shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath logs\capture-bookmark-foreground.py -Value $capture -Encoding utf8

git checkout main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout main failed" }
git reset --hard origin/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "reset main failed" }
cmd /c build.bat Release
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "main Release build failed" }
$env:BOOKMARK_VISUAL_MODE="before"
python -X utf8 logs\capture-bookmark-foreground.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "foreground before capture failed" }

git checkout work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout work branch failed" }
git merge --ff-only origin/work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "work branch ff failed" }
cmd /c build.bat Release
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "bookmark Release build failed" }
$env:BOOKMARK_VISUAL_MODE="after"
python -X utf8 logs\capture-bookmark-foreground.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "foreground after capture failed" }

python -X utf8 -c "from PIL import Image,ImageChops,ImageStat; from pathlib import Path; b=Image.open('logs/bookmark-visual-before-foreground.png').convert('RGB'); a=Image.open('logs/bookmark-visual-after-foreground.png').convert('RGB'); d=ImageChops.difference(b,a); print('VISUAL_SIZES',b.size,a.size); print('VISUAL_DIFF_BBOX',d.getbbox()); print('VISUAL_DIFF_MEAN',tuple(round(x,3) for x in ImageStat.Stat(d).mean))"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "visual comparison metadata failed" }

# Publish only temporary visual evidence; never alter main.
git switch --detach origin/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "detach failed" }
git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/evidence/bookmark-visual
if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
  git branch -D evidence/bookmark-visual
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "delete local evidence branch failed" }
}
git switch -c evidence/bookmark-visual
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "create evidence branch failed" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path evidence\bookmark-visual | Out-Null
Copy-Item logs\bookmark-visual-before-foreground.png evidence\bookmark-visual\before.png -Force
Copy-Item logs\bookmark-visual-after-foreground.png evidence\bookmark-visual\after.png -Force
git add -f evidence\bookmark-visual\before.png evidence\bookmark-visual\after.png
git -c user.name="flyExplorer Validation" -c user.email="actions@users.noreply.github.com" commit -m "evidence: replace bookmark visual acceptance captures"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "evidence commit failed" }
git push --force origin evidence/bookmark-visual
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "evidence push failed" }
git checkout work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "restore work branch failed" }
git merge --ff-only origin/work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "restore work head failed" }
Write-Host "BOOKMARK_FOREGROUND_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_PASS"
